title: The fractional Porous Medium Equation on graphs
summary: We study the fractional porous medium equation on connected infinite graphs with no local finiteness assumption. We introduce a notion of weak dual solution adapted to the discrete setting, and establish existence results for nonnegative initial data belonging to a weighted space defined through the fractional Green function, extending beyond the classical $\ell^1$ framework. Our approach relies on weighted estimates and on a detailed analysis of the associated fractional Green function.
